folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B230, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All source/family/lifecycle/relationship/code/succession/engine rows, five proposed proof cases and32 texture moments were reviewed. Kin needs a basis: progenitor, donor, maker, animator, incubator, caregiver, adoptive parent, household member, officeholder and chosen relative may be different participants. Shared production, scent, forge mark or kin vocabulary does not itself establish love, command, legal title, genetic descent or a shared mind. Anonymous contributor may remain unknown; revealed/claimed kin differs from hidden structural truth. These records should serve actual care, greeting, help or succession readers rather than another all-purpose relationship score (AD32/AD36).

The heir audit’s narrow distinctions remain useful. recipient=kin/apprentice was a label, not a named genealogical child or body recipe; the estate helper did not itself construct a human. The full builder’s expansion replacement could discard a selected body or surviving simulation household, which copying npc_lives alone would not preserve. These are historical inspected seams, not reverified current defects. A new plan must trace the current full-envelope builder, actual recipient, retained people, allocated stock and duties. A continuing repaired mind is not an heir, and one sentient body-item must not be applied both as the person and a duplicate bequest. Existing half-standing policy is local compatibility, not universal family law.

NK-E2’s no-birth-cycle line is an ordinary chronological-ancestry default. Preserve valid person/body/life/epoch and source-qualified causal origin if a selected time/return mechanism creates a different shape; do not reject a reasonable world solely to force every relationship graph into a DAG. Chosen kin and households can already have cycles. Shared origin can derive hatchmates without all-pairs storage while named individual evidence, care and exceptional histories remain retained. Unknown parentage is not inferred from a species template, and a prospective egg/entity is not automatically an adult worker or a duplicate person on emergence (AD5/AD38).

Care can be passive warmth, an actual caregiver task, communal support or capable self-care with its real means. Birth supplies neither free player attention nor mandatory baby-care clicks; ordinary life and optional strong inherited faculties remain available under their mechanisms. Dependence can persist into adulthood without erasing agency. Family continuity needs current home access, vacancy and still-owed care rather than restored old snapshots. Learned loss, actual death and notification are separate, and repair/copy/reincarnation require their own identity evidence. The fixed body-age/adult-appearance constraint retains its attributed owner; it does not authenticate surrounding proposed biology or family law.

Source rows remain bounded summaries, secondary claims or MEMORY leads, including separate five-book continuities, manga/anime variants and supplied-MTL aliases. Keep NK-C14’s repaired false-origin correction rather than reviving the superseded assertion. A repeated source synthesis is not independent canon proof. NK-M cues need actual perceivers and events; they create no extra estate, birth or growth effects. Current broad scope, Klein/LOTM/Harry direction, desktop/prose-first targets and AD42/AD51/AD52 qualify old milestone/first-slice/gate language. No kin schema, birth, body, recipient, care task, control, estate migration, native behavior or persistence proof was implemented or executed here.
